_comment: Metres per tile, per layer, in the order the loader binds them:
0 ground (Grass005), 1 rock (Rock063), 2 high (Gravel043), 3 sediment (Ground037) -- the order in TERRAIN_LAYER_FILES.
These are PHYSICAL SIZES, not taste. Every layer here is an ambientCG
surface material, and ambientCG authors its surface scans against a 2 m
square unless the asset page says otherwise. Tiling one over 8 m stretches
it 4x, which is why the grass read as blurry beside a marble column whose
brush UVs were already close to life size -- the same texel budget spread
If a specific asset turns out to be authored at 1 m or 4 m, change that one
number rather than scaling the set: they are independent measurements.
